mode: scoped ideas/design followed by requested execution
objective: Resolve the four accepted finite followups: existing two-swap custody, public pair-sum collision rank, per-complete-instance accounting, and rotated-window normal-basis membership.

authorization.scope: Finite public synthetic mathematics and additive archive audit only

allowed: Custody and completeness of existing immutable archives
Exact finite equal-group-sum collision counts and coefficient-matrix ranks for four fixed n19 bases
Descriptive measured cost prefixes and missing-cost inventory from existing receipts
Exact finite Boolean membership equivalence, basis conversion, eligible curve/subgroup counts, and static representation size

Global optimality, asymptotic, novelty or cryptanalytic improvement claims
Treating Frobenius rotation as free for a fixed target
Treating membership-only validation as full SAT decomposition validation

parameters.seed_policy: No newly random science. Lexicographic ordering, exact enumeration, and retained source corpus seeds only.

collision_method: Validate every manifest point on y^2+xy=x^3+x^2+1 and [r]P=O, point count uniqueness and declared curve parameters. Verify each public point label [column,coefficient] by public scalar multiplication of its declared representative. Never solve a discrete logarithm.

Enumerate unordered pairs 0<=i<=j<M including repeated points; retain pair counts M(M+1)/2. Partition by exact full group sum (x,y), with identity a distinct key. A hash-slot collision is not an equal-group-sum collision.

For each sum bucket, form all unordered pairs of distinct pair entries. Record equality witness and compressed row label(P_i)+label(P_j)-label(P_u)-label(P_v) in F_r^k. Validate group equality independently from coordinates.

Report bucket multiplicity, raw equal-sum pair count, identity-bucket count, zero rows, exact row duplicates, projective/scalar duplicate classes, and modular matrix rank. Use canonical pivot order. Compare all collision rows with anchor-difference rows (each bucket member minus lexicographically first member); ranks must agree. Uncompressed point-coordinate rank is optional and must be separately labeled.
Preserve rank-increment witnesses and exact row span certificate sufficient for replay. Counts and ranks are observations only.
controls: For every exact sum bucket, self-pair subtraction is zero and cannot increase rank.
Perturb one public label coefficient by +1 mod r for the first manifest point; the independent public point-label identity check must reject it.
Use a deliberately one-slot hash bucket on distinct group sums; confirm it produces slot collisions which exact group-key comparison rejects as relations.
Independent replay changes insertion order and obtains identical sum multiplicities and row rank. No reliance on production hash-slot implementation.
cost_method: Consume only the two exact retained receipt sets above: 72 processes, 288 source corpora, expected 2359296 retained relation receipts. Stream rows and hash inputs; do not materialize all receipts.

For each source corpus in original trial order, independently recompute rank of sparse_row over F_r until the declared full column count is reached. Record actual first full-column-rank trial and accepted-relation count. Record the original rank+32 milestone and verify it from the retained stream under the source definition. Never solve the linear system for target or orbit values.

At each milestone sum available per-relation query_ms, query_group_additions, query_paid_chunks, query_table_lookups and query_table_probe_steps. Separate measured query prefixes from other operations. Cross-check full-stream totals against the source process summary where compatible.

Charge curve setup and the complete one-time support setup once for the separately considered instance. Show explicit retained-amortized setup alongside it. Distinguish source support_setup_without_corpus_custody_ms, public corpus import/custody, base construction, receipt construction, rank diagnostics, linear solve evidence, validation and outer wall time to avoid double counting.

The measured complete-instance total is null unless every required component for that exact prefix was timed. Present setup+query as an identified partial subtotal, never as complete elapsed cost. Aggregate rank/solve/preparation timers cannot be scaled proportionally and called measured. Any illustrative extrapolation must be a separate estimate with formula, assumptions and unavailable components.

Source corpus generation and receipt validation can be shown as evidence overhead separately, with complete process wall time also retained. Do not claim those costs disappear from end-to-end deployment. Do not output recovered scalars from source fixtures.

Compare arms only within their existing shared source block/corpus. Do not splice the two source runs into a fictitious paired four-arm experiment. Descriptive median/range and per-corpus rows suffice; no new statistical winner selection.

288 cost rows with both actual milestones or explicit missing/invalid status
Every total states measured, partial, estimate or unavailable
Input hashes, exact command, environment, resources, source/snapshot commit and dirty state retained

membership.definition: For normal-coordinate word c in F_2^n, W_s={s,s+1,...,s+d-1} mod n. U(n,d)={c: support(c) is contained in W_s for at least one s in 0..n-1}. Include the zero word in raw U; rational and subgroup filtering are separate.
membership.normal_basis: Select the least positive polynomial-basis integer beta whose ordered conjugates beta^(2^j), j=0..n-1, have binary rank n. Preserve columns, inverse map and beta. Verify modulus irreducibility, map roundtrip, and Frobenius action before membership accounting.
method: Exhaust every normal-coordinate word (128 at n7, 524288 at n19) independently for every frozen width. Compare direct support containment against the set constructed by union of all n rotations of all 2^d window assignments. Record raw cardinality, overlap/multiplicity distribution, unique rotation orbits and orbit lengths; do not assume n*2^d distinct members.

Compare the explicit predicate/circuit or emitted definitional CNF with the set oracle for every input. Auxiliary variables must have exact existential semantics, not merely one arbitrary satisfying assignment. Static gate/CNF/trie counts are representation metrics only. A rotation-disjunction encoding and explicit membership trie are the two fixed representation controls, with emitted sizes and construction cost reported.

Convert each raw member to the frozen polynomial field. Count separately raw field values, x values admitting a rational point on the curve, rational affine points, x values admitting a nonidentity r-subgroup point, subgroup affine points, and those excluded by cofactor/subgroup checks. Recover y only to verify finite point membership; do not use target scalar data.

For every admitted point verify the curve equation and [r]P=O exactly. At x=0 handle the exceptional point explicitly; do not silently apply division by x. Half-trace is allowed for odd n with equation verification; n7 additionally permits independent exhaustive y enumeration.

Verify Frobenius rotation versus field squaring for every coordinate basis vector and all raw members. Report no free fixed-target rotation assumption. Account for conversion and additional curve/subgroup predicates separately from raw Boolean membership.
Retain exact accepted coordinate/point lists and rejected examples for independent replay; duplicates remain reflected in multiplicity counts.
controls: Replace full rotation union with only the s=0 window: require an explicit word in the true union rejected by this incorrect predicate for each width. Reversing all rotations is not a negative control because the full union is unchanged.

Use a noncyclic swap of normal-basis columns 1 and 2 as the wrong mapping and require a Frobenius-action mismatch witness. Preserve an exact roundtrip check separately: an invertible wrong map can still pass roundtrip.

At n7 validate candidate rational-point membership by independent exhaustive y enumeration, and all subgroup memberships by [r]P=O. At n19 verify recovered y pairs and compare subgroup eligibility against a separate cofactor-image or public group enumeration oracle.
Independent replay uses a second implementation of set construction and polynomial multiplication/basis mapping; producer agreement alone is not independent review.
completion: All eight (n,width) cases terminal with exact assignment counts
No predicate, mapping, rational-membership or subgroup mismatch
Every intended negative control rejects and retains a witness
No full SAT decomposition or integration PASS label

dependent_105_partition_gate.reason: Distinct integration task must be frozen after membership/rational/subgroup representation passes independent review. This protocol does not substitute a membership truth table for decomposition validation.
dependent_105_partition_gate.required_contract: Use the exact prior n7 105-formula partition domain with identical relation coefficients, liftability and subgroup constraints; compare complete SAT truth and recovered witness sets against exhaustive curve enumeration with known-false/null formulas. Freeze each formula/input hash, solver/encoding versions and expected truth set before execution. All 105 formulas must complete and have equivalent projected witness sets before full partition gate can pass.
dependent_105_partition_gate.revisit_trigger: Independent membership verification passed with sizes and additional constraint costs retained

proof_search_map.scope: Finite predicate/interface and rank certificates, not an asymptotic theorem
proof_search_map.exact_baseline: Four byte-pinned source manifests; direct support oracle and explicit trie; source rank receipts and exact one-time setup columns
proof_search_map.observation_collision: Raw equal-sum multiplicities vs compressed rank; coinciding rotated support words; wrong invertible mapping with roundtrip but wrong Frobenius action
proof_search_map.quantifier_order: Fix field, ordered normal basis, width and all four existing manifests before enumerating every finite member/pair. No target-dependent base choice or tuning after results.
proof_search_map.method_ceiling: A finite truth table establishes only the listed field sizes and widths. Collision rank is over the listed label space only; static membership size does not establish SAT or target-solving complexity.
proof_search_map.nearby_object: Single-window wrong predicate, noncyclic wrong basis permutation, corrupted label and degenerate hash slot

lean_formalization.missing: No frozen Lean definition/serialization interface for this exact polynomial-bit ordering, existential membership encoding and emitted finite table certificate in this package.
lean_formalization.revisit_trigger: Before promoting a general predicate theorem or finite-certificate proof claim; freeze definitions and a checker correspondence lemma under separate handoff.

resources.maximum_runs_meaning: Exactly two frozen audit lanes, not a spending cap; no new scientific trials.
resources.watchdog_rationale: Process liveness and checkpoint protection only; retain partial artifacts and resume same deterministic case after assessment.

stopping_rules: Any hash, equation, rank, basis, predicate or required-control mismatch yields completed_invalid or failed_implementation as appropriate, with exact counterexample retained. Do not continue dependent case selection under an invalid gate.
Missing input or runtime failure yields failed_infrastructure, not mathematical rejection. Preserve all stdout/stderr and partial output.
Complete exactly four collision bases, two existing retained receipt sets and eight membership cases. Any expansion or changed scientific criterion requires an additive amendment.

archive.pre_execution: Commit protocol.json, approval.md and exact handoffs into isolated scoped branch before execution. Publication state recorded separately; no official science promotion from unpublished artifacts.
